prompt: Image 1 is the STYLE reference: match its warm sunlit terracotta-beige plaster wall with soft dappled leaf shadows, the light-oak floor, the camera height, the lens, the warm late-afternoon light and the colour grading exactly, so both photos look like the same photoshoot. Image 2 shows boop's 3D-printed pet name tags (bone, paw, heart, cloud, cat-head and bubble-letter shapes, coloured base with white raised letters). Create ONE new wide photograph in that exact setting. The UPPER 55% of the frame is calm empty wall with leaf shadows only: nothing reaches into it, no ears, no heads. Everything sits low, entirely inside the LOWER 42% of the frame. Left: a fawn French bulldog lying down with its chin on its paws, wearing a tan collar with ONE blush pink paw-shaped name tag. Right: a grey British Shorthair cat lying in a loaf pose, wearing a soft collar with ONE lavender cat-head shaped name tag. Between them on the oak floor, neatly scattered in a loose row, five larger name tags from image 2: a sage green bone, a cherry red heart, a sky blue cloud with a small rainbow, a red mushroom with white dots, a red strawberry with green leaves, each with a steel split ring. Keep all tag lettering small and simple; do not invent any other text. Photorealistic, no logos.
